div.l: He mote as wel seyn / o word as a nother
Cryst spak hym self / right brood in holy wryt
And wel ye wetyn / no velanye is it
Eek plato seyth / who so can hym rede
The wordys mot be ss cosyn / to the dede
And also I pray yow / for yeve it me
Al have I set folk / nat in here degre
Here in this tale / as they sholde stonde
My wit is short / ye may wel vndyrstande
GReet cheer maade / our host vs euerichoıı̄un
And to the souper / set he vs a nooıı̄un
He serued vs with · vitayle / at the beste
Strong was the wyn / and weel to drynke vs liste
A semely man / our host / was withall
For to have ben / a marchall in an hall
A large man he was / with eyen stepe
A fayrere burgeys / is ther noon in chepe
Boold of his speche / wys and wel I tawht
And of manhod / hym lacked ryht nowht
Eek ther to he was / right a mery man ·
And after souper / pleyen he bi gan ·
And spak of myrthe / a moong other thynges
Whan that we hadde maade / our reknynges
And said thus / now lordynges trewly
Ye ben to me wolcom̄e / right herttyly
For bi my trouthe / if that I shal nat lye
I saw nat this yeer / such a companye
Attones in this herberwe / as is nowe
Fayn wolde I doon you myrthe / wiste I how
And of a myrthe / I am right now bi thouht
To doon yow ese / and it shal · coste yow nought
Ye gon to Cauntirbury / god yow spede
The blisful martyr / qwyte yow yowr mede
